_comment: Symptom-condition associations for the initial, lower-risk scope. Each association is transcribed from the cited passage (quote must appear verbatim in corpus.jsonl; enforced by tests/test_grounding.py). These rules were written by the software author from public NHS / MedlinePlus / WHO patient information and have NOT been reviewed by a clinician. role=key: a characteristic feature named in the source's main symptom list; role=supporting: listed as a possible/additional symptom. `not_typical`: reported findings the sources link to a different cause. `required_any`: the condition is not suggested unless at least one of these is present. Self-care items are deliberately limited to non-drug measures; medicine questions are directed to a pharmacist or doctor.

description.en: Itchy, dry or blistered skin caused by contact with an irritant (such as soap, detergent or frequent water) or something you are allergic to.
description.hi: Kisi irritant (jaise sabun, detergent ya baar-baar paani) ya allergy wali cheez ke contact se skin par khujli, rookhapan ya chhaale.

description_evidence.quote: Contact dermatitis is a type of eczema triggered by contact with a particular substance.

evidence.quote: Contact dermatitis causes the skin to become itchy, blistered, dry and cracked.
Lighter skin can become red, and darker skin can become dark brown, purple or grey.
Contact dermatitis causes the skin to become itchy, blistered, dry and cracked.
Contact dermatitis causes the skin to become itchy, blistered, dry and cracked.
This reaction usually occurs within a few hours or days of exposure to an irritant or allergen.

self_care.en: Identify and avoid the substance causing the problem — the skin usually improves once it is avoided.
self_care.hi: Jis cheez se problem ho rahi hai use pehchaan kar avoid karein — aam taur par skin phir theek ho jaati hai.

evidence.quote: Contact dermatitis usually improves or clears up completely if the substance causing the problem is identified and avoided.

self_care.en: If you touch an irritant, rinse the skin with warm water as soon as possible; wear gloves to protect your hands.
self_care.hi: Irritant ke contact mein aane par skin ko turant gungune paani se dhoyein; haathon ki suraksha ke liye gloves pehnein.

evidence.quote: using gloves to protect your hands

self_care.en: Moisturisers (emollients) help stop the skin becoming dry; a pharmacist can advise.
self_care.hi: Moisturiser (emollient) skin ko rookha hone se bachaate hain; pharmacist se salah lein.

evidence.quote: They can recommend treatments such as emollients (moisturisers) , which you rub on your skin to stop it becoming dry.

see_doctor_if.en: Symptoms are persistent, keep coming back, or are severe.
see_doctor_if.hi: Symptoms lagataar rahein, baar-baar aayein, ya tez hon.

evidence.quote: See a GP if you have persistent, recurrent or severe symptoms of contact dermatitis.

description.en: An itchy rash of raised bumps or patches that can appear anywhere on the body, triggered by things like certain foods, heat, stress, medicines, insect bites or infections.
description.hi: Ubhre hue khujli wale chakatte jo shareer par kahin bhi ho sakte hain — kuch khaane, garmi, stress, dawai, keede ke kaatne ya infection se trigger ho sakte hain.

description_evidence.quote: The main symptom of hives is an itchy rash.

evidence.quote: be raised bumps or patches in many shapes and sizes
The main symptom of hives is an itchy rash.
appear anywhere on the body
hot, sweaty skin from exercise, emotional stress or eating spicy food
hot, sweaty skin from exercise, emotional stress or eating spicy food

self_care.en: Try to find out what triggers your hives so you can avoid it.
self_care.hi: Pata lagaane ki koshish karein ki pitti kis cheez se hoti hai, taaki use avoid kar sakein.

evidence.quote: Try to find out what triggers hives for you, so you can avoid those triggers, if possible.

self_care.en: A pharmacist can advise on allergy treatment for a hives rash; tell them about any long-term conditions.
self_care.hi: Pitti ke ilaaj ke liye pharmacist salah de sakte hain; unhe apni kisi lambi bimari ke baare mein zaroor batayein.

evidence.quote: Tell the pharmacist if you have a long-term condition

see_doctor_if.en: It does not improve after 2 days, is spreading, keeps coming back, or you also have a high temperature.
see_doctor_if.hi: 2 din mein sudhaar na ho, phail raha ho, baar-baar ho, ya saath mein tez bukhar ho.

evidence.quote: symptoms of hives do not improve after 2 days

see_doctor_if.en: Swelling of lips, mouth, throat or tongue, or difficulty breathing — call 112/108 immediately.
see_doctor_if.hi: Hoth, munh, gale ya jeebh mein sujan, ya saans lene mein takleef — turant 112/108 call karein.

evidence.quote: your lips, mouth, throat or tongue suddenly become swollen

description.en: Small raised spots with an itchy, prickly feeling, usually caused by sweating a lot when sweat glands get blocked.
description.hi: Chhote ubhre daane jinme khujli aur chubhan hoti hai — aam taur par zyada paseene se, jab paseene ki granthiyan band ho jaati hain.

description_evidence.quote: Heat rash is usually caused by sweating a lot.

evidence.quote: small, raised spots
an itchy, prickly feeling
small, raised spots
Heat rash is usually caused by sweating a lot.

self_care.en: Keep your skin cool: wear loose cotton clothing, take cool baths or showers, and drink plenty of fluids.
self_care.hi: Skin ko thanda rakhein: dheele cotton ke kapde pehnein, thande paani se nahaayein, aur khoob paani piyein.

evidence.quote: Wear loose cotton clothing.

self_care.en: Pat or tap the rash instead of scratching, and avoid perfumed shower gels or creams.
self_care.hi: Khujaane ki jagah halke se thapthapaayein, aur khushboo wale soap/cream avoid karein.

evidence.quote: Tap or pat the rash instead of scratching it.

see_doctor_if.en: It does not improve after a few days.
see_doctor_if.hi: Kuch dinon mein sudhaar na ho.

evidence.quote: you have heat rash that does not improve after a few days
